purpose: Decide whether mechanisms can be represented as SMILES state sequences instead of PGL.
V1_mapping: GT paths rendered as SMILES; RXNMapper on each consecutive pair; heavy-atom bond changes (element-pair multisets) vs GT. Adequate for sigma-event analysis if >= 90% of steps are recovered.
V2_generation: gemini (two-gateway client) writes full stepwise SMILES mechanisms (M1, M2) on the 147 J3 cases, same inputs as S. Species-level scoring with sigma-graph keys.

decision.switch_to_smiles: M1 parse rate >= 95% AND M1 heavy hidden-event recall >= PGL E (species-level) AND the law holds (hidden < visible species recall; all-present falls with hidden events)
decision.inertness_persists_in_smiles: heavy hidden events omitted in M1: known in other narratives exceeds re-appearance in M2 by >= 15 pp
